name: apple-and-icloud-mail
description: IMAPIIe Now — platform-agnostic IMAP setup guidance and bounded connection checks.

interface.longDescription: IMAPIIe Now (canonical ID apple-and-icloud-mail) — portable open-source guidance for IMAP setup and bounded connection checks using separately configured tools. The name combines IMAP + IIe (two capital I's after IMAP). Community project; no Apple affiliation. Calendar, Contacts, Drive, Photos, and other Apple services are outside version 0.1.0.
defaultPrompt: Use IMAPIIe Now to review my IMAP setup without authenticating.
